heading: **6 February 2026**
body:
*EcoRV digestion assay*

Running order:

1. ELFlig1  
2. ELFlig1 (EcoRV)  
3. ELFlig1nuc (EcoRV)  
4. ELFlig1 \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)  
5. ELFlig1nuc \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)

To run this gel, run at 60 V, 2 hours and do not load more than 6 uL of sample into the wells. Run in a cold room. Cast the gel and run the gel in the TBE buffer.

*Nuclease testing assay for dam-/dcm- pHRS plasmids*

![](assets/img/doc3-image11.png)

Heat the duplex at 95 C, 5 mins. Remove from thermocycler and allow cooling to RT gradually.

![](assets/img/doc3-image12.png)

Here we use the Cas9 dilution buffer instead of PBS.

Incubate at RT for 10 mins.

![](assets/img/doc3-image13.png)

Corresponding to 100 nM DNA substrate is about 6 ug DNA. We are just going to test this with 1 ug DNA.

10X Cas9 Nuclease reaction buffer:

1 mL

| 1 M HEPES  | 200 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| NaCl | 0.06 g |
| 1 M MgCl2 | 50 uL |
| 0.5 M EDTA | 2 uL |

Filter and store at \-20 before usage.

Cas9 dilution Buffer:

10 mL

| 1 M HEPES  | 300 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 4 M KCl | 375 uL |
